fit_reason: Private owner selling a complete 14ft aluminum Lund fishing boat with outboard and trailer.
findings: Dull, slightly chalky look to the bare aluminum lower hull on both sides
Red painted upper hull band looks a bit flat rather than glossy
Light grime and dirt in the floor of the hull between the bench seats
Gear (rope, anchor, net, minnow bucket) piled in the bow area making the interior look cluttered
Weathered, faded finish on the wooden bench seat tops
Some scuffing and dirt on the outboard lower unit and cowling
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 1989 Lund and outboard package. It looks like a solid boat, and a cleanout of the hull floor plus a polish on the red band and aluminum sides would really help it pop in photos. We do pre-sale boat details and come to you. Would you like a quote?
